About.heroDesc: I'm a registered nurse in Accident & Emergency in Finland, and a language coach. I learned Finnish as an adult, on the job, so I know how hard it can be. Now I help other nurses get there faster.
About.bgP1: I graduated in 2005 from JAMK University of Applied Sciences in Jyväskylä.
About.bgP2: I have worked in elderly care, geriatric wards, medical wards, cardiac units, and emergency departments.
About.bgP3: My main experience is in Accident & Emergency.
About.bgP4: I learned Finnish through courses and real work experience and hold certificates from JAMK and the University of Helsinki.
About.bgP5: I teach clinical Finnish to nurses who already have B2 level or higher.
About.clinical1Body: Triage, urgent care and fast communication in a team.
About.clinical2Body: Caring for and monitoring cardiac patients.
About.clinical4Body: Caring for older patients, from home care to palliative care.
About.philQuote: Healthcare Finnish is not about being perfect. It's about being understood — by your patient, your colleague, and yourself in a high-pressure moment.
About.philBody: Every session is built around real situations. No grammar drills, no long word lists. Just the Finnish you'll use on your next shift.

Courses.heroDesc: All sessions are online and fit around your shifts. You'll need Finnish at B2 level or above.

Courses.faq1Q: What level of Finnish do I need?
Courses.faq1A: My courses are for nurses with B2-level Finnish or above. Not sure where you are? Book a free intro call and I'll help you find out.
Courses.faq2A: All sessions are online by video call (Zoom or Teams). You just need a good internet connection and a quiet place.
Courses.faq3Q: Can I do both group and 1-on-1?
Courses.faq3A: Yes! Many of my students take group sessions for general clinical vocabulary, then add 1-on-1 sessions for their own department.
Courses.faq4A: I'll get in touch within 3 working days to arrange a short intro call, confirm your background, and agree on a schedule.
